about: A series of takes: every few seconds the person, outline and all, is snapshotted out of the video into its own layer. Takes age, dissolve to nothing and are deleted (the engine's history ring in cutout mode); nothing accumulates, so nothing smudges. The live picture can be dialled to black behind them.

backing.label: Live background
backing.hint: 1 = the full live picture behind everything, 0 = black; the person and the takes remain

takes.label: Takes opacity
takes.hint: how solidly the takes sit over the background

take_every.label: Seconds between takes
take_every.hint: a new take this often; six are kept, the oldest is deleted

take_count.label: Takes kept
take_count.hint: its own layer each; one falls off the end as a new one arrives

life.label: Take life (seconds)
life.hint: how long a take lives; it fades and dissolves continuously over this time, as fast as you like

dissolve.label: Dissolve
dissolve.hint: 0 = takes fade evenly, 1 = they are eaten away in a ragged pattern as they age

grain.label: Dissolve grain
grain.hint: size of the eaten pattern; bigger = finer

tint.label: Tint the takes
tint.hint: 0 = the takes keep the video's colours, 1 = fully coloured by the hue

live_solid.label: The person now
live_solid.hint: how solid the live person stands over the takes

outline_size.label: Outline size
outline_size.hint: the outline's width in screen heights, up to very fat; burned into each take at capture

glow.label: Outline glow
glow.hint: the edge trail from the outline seeds (the feedback frame)

fade.label: Outline trail length
fade.hint: how much of the edge trail survives each step

feed:
// the feedback frame carries only the outline seeds (drawn in by the Stage); they fade into a trail
ret = frame(uv) * fade;
